name: vraunix-studio
description: Vraunix Studio public website and business operations platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @vraunix/api" "npm run dev -w @vraunix/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @vraunix/api && npm run build -w @vraunix/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @vraunix/shared && npm run typecheck -w @vraunix/api && npm run typecheck -w @vraunix/web
